title: noticeFacts v1
description: Facts extracted from one notice group. Stored on every copy of the group as `facts`; the previous version moves to the copy's own `factsHistory`. The group is the server's dedup key (trimmed title + contentHash) at extraction time: a body edit changes the key, so nothing long-lived (seriesKey, saves, reminders, change tokens) may key on the group id.

evidence.description: Where a fact is stated. The product opens the original with this span highlighted.

start.description: Character offset of the quote in the source text (contentText, the title or the poster transcription), located by code.

match.description: How the quote was located. Facts whose quote is not found are not stored.

tag.description: The label shown before the fact in a shared block (tracks.py), "" when it applies to the whole notice.

tagBy.description: Which rule set the tag: the fact's own label, a declared track section, its thing's name, or the verifier's scope check (v3.10).

dateParts.description: One point of a dated item as the model wrote it (codebook v3.6). Unresolved: an unwritten part is X, a post-relative day is "post". A key the model did not write is absent.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD with X for every unwritten part ("XXXX-09-30"), "post", or "".

week.description: Week of the month ("11월 4주"), 0 when not written.

offset.description: Units of granularity from the post, for anchor post.

v.description: Schema version of this namespace. Optional fields added later (`anchorDay`, `times[].dateInput`, 2026-10-28) do not change it. The version never makes a record stale: only `inputHash` and the copy's `groupId` stamp do.

anchorDay.description: Optional, from 2026-10-28. The KST day the group was first seen, which the dates were resolved against (unwritten years, post-relative days). With `times[].dateInput` it lets code resolve the dates again under a changed rule without a model call (record.reresolve).

codebook.description: Codebook version the prompts cite, e.g. "v3.1".

inputHash.description: Hash of title + contentText + poster transcriptions the facts were extracted from; a new hash triggers re-extraction.

models.description: Models in call order, e.g. [haiku-5.5 poster, haiku-5.5 agenda, haiku-5.5 details].

escalated.description: A trigger sent the notice to the Sonnet pass.

items.description: trigger: "dates" (days the extraction did not quote), or "escalation_failed:<code>" (a record with it is never stored since v3.8).

sources.description: The citable sources besides title and body.

transcript.description: Verbatim transcription (vision stage). Quotes with src poster:N are checked against it.

unreadable.description: Present only when the source no longer serves an image at url (404, 410 or not an image). The notice was read text-only. A poster that failed for any other reason fails the extraction instead, so it is never stored.

links.description: Links in the body, and QR codes decoded by code from posters.

role.description: Model judgment from the file name.

label.description: 2-8 character Korean role name, e.g. 신청서.

things.description: Named objects the notice is about. Every other fact points to one.

id.description: Stable id: hash of (kind, normalised name). Unique within the notice and stable across its versions, so versions can be diffed. Never derived from the group id.

main.description: The thing the title announces; exactly one is true.

capacity.description: Evidence, or null when the notice does not state it.

duration.description: Evidence, or null when the notice does not state it.

visits.description: Evidence, or null when the notice does not state it.

inTitle.description: Code: the thing's name is quoted from the title, or appears in it verbatim. The row reads the main thing and every thing the title names.

anchorEv.description: The words that introduce the thing (codebook v3.6), located, or null.

section.description: The part of the notice about only this thing, or null for the whole notice.

short.description: A verbatim part of a long name that tells the thing apart (codebook v3.8 "full :: short"); tags use it. "" when none.

tracks.description: Declared track sections (codebook v3.7): the part of the notice about one track alone.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the notice: hash of (thing id, kind, normalised track, start date or else end date or else the normalised quote), so a window keeps its id when its deadline moves. Items that share that hash also hash their end date, start and end times and normalised quote; any still alike take -2, -3, … in source order.

verb.description: Verbatim verb or state (신청, 휴관, 운행 중단, 면접), or "".

track.description: Verbatim group or round label when several items of one kind differ by group (1차, 인사캠, 신규신청자), or "".

start.description: A time point, as written. Code fills only a year the text does not write; it never corrects a written date.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD as written, or "" when the text names no calendar day (shown as the quote).

yearFilled.description: The text wrote no year; code filled it by rule 0.5 against the anchor (the KST day the quote first appeared).

tentative.description: Code: an exact day marked 예정/잠정 in the quote. Rendered as the date + 예정.

fuzzy.description: Code: 초순/중순/하순, 월 초·중·말, N주, 경/무렵, or a month without a day. Rendered as written.

latest.description: Code, for fuzzy points: the latest day it can mean (중순 -> 20th, 말 -> last day). Status uses it, so nothing closes early. "" otherwise.

after.description: mod AFTER: the lower bound day (YYYY-MM-DD); the point itself has no date.

end.description: A time point, as written. Code fills only a year the text does not write; it never corrects a written date.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD as written, or "" when the text names no calendar day (shown as the quote).

yearFilled.description: The text wrote no year; code filled it by rule 0.5 against the anchor (the KST day the quote first appeared).

tentative.description: Code: an exact day marked 예정/잠정 in the quote. Rendered as the date + 예정.

fuzzy.description: Code: 초순/중순/하순, 월 초·중·말, N주, 경/무렵, or a month without a day. Rendered as written.

latest.description: Code, for fuzzy points: the latest day it can mean (중순 -> 20th, 말 -> last day). Status uses it, so nothing closes early. "" otherwise.

dateInput.description: Optional, from 2026-10-28. The resolver's input, not its result: what dates.py reads of this item, as the model wrote it (codebook v3.6 date parts). `start`, `end`, `dateWarnings`, `dateChecked`, `occurrences` and `id` are computed from it and `anchorDay`. Consumers read the resolved fields, never this one.

anchor.description: As the model wrote it: explicit, post, previous or other.

granularity.description: As the model wrote it: day, week or month.

mod.description: As the model wrote it: "", START, MID, END, APPROX, AFTER or BEFORE.

tentative.description: As the model wrote it: an exact day marked 예정/잠정.

dateChecked.description: Code: every normalised date's month and day appear in the quote. A date that fails is a model error and is dropped (unlike dateWarnings, which flag the source).

occurrences.description: Dates of a repeat series, expanded by code (empty when not a series).

where.description: Place of a session, period or step.

ev.description: Evidence, or null when the notice does not state it.

places.description: Each place, resolved by code (never by the model).

items.description: One place as written, and what the deterministic resolver made of it.

campus.description: Campus of the resolved id; null when unresolved.

reason.description: Why it is unresolved: online, offcampus, campus_only, not_a_place, unknown_place, ambiguous. Null when resolved.

relativeTo.description: Derived from anchor: post, other, or empty.

dateWarnings.description: Code's sanity flags on dates kept as written. A flagged date never on its own makes an item 마감 and gets no urgency colour; the product shows it as written with a warning marker.

actor.description: Model judgment (codebook v3.2): who acts in the item. Only `reader` items drive the row. A v3.1 record has `reader`.

dayEv.description: The day heading the item's date comes from (codebook v3.2 dayQuote), or null.

entry.description: Model judgment (codebook v3.4): doing this window's action is how a reader gets in (apply, register, sign up). Entry windows decide the row before later windows. Defaults to true for a window in older records.

anchor.description: Model (codebook v3.6): where the date comes from; code resolves post and previous, leaves other unresolved.

mod.description: How the text bounds the point; AFTER is never the written day itself (the point keeps it as `after`).

recurrence.description: A regular series; occurrences are expanded with dateutil's rrule.

unattached.description: Present when the fact lies outside its thing's section and does not name the thing; it never reaches the row.

appliesTo.description: Every track label or thing id a fact stated once for several covers (codebook v3.7 shared items); [] otherwise.

tag.description: The label shown before the fact in a shared block (tracks.py), "" when it applies to the whole notice.

tagBy.description: Which rule set the tag: the fact's own label, a declared track section, its thing's name, or the verifier's scope check (v3.10).

instant.description: A first-come opening (codebook v3.7 kind `opening`): it ends on its start day.

statusStatements.description: Undated statements of state; code combines them with the windows into the status at render time.

tag.description: The label shown before the fact in a shared block (tracks.py), "" when it applies to the whole notice.

tagBy.description: Which rule set the tag: the fact's own label, a declared track section, its thing's name, or the verifier's scope check (v3.10).

statedChanges.description: Changes the notice itself announces (장소 변경 A → B).

items.description: A change the notice itself announces. Any statedChange fires a change token (owner, 2026-10-25), in addition to the 14-day diff of dates, places and status.

from.description: Evidence, or null when the notice does not state it.

forStudents.description: Model judgment: can a current student act on it. Products act only on `no` and treat `unknown` as `yes`.

conditions.description: One per listed item or restricting clause.

polarity.description: Model judgment: include = must hold; exclude = must not hold; also = widens the audience. Never changed by code; the verifier re-checks it.

scope.description: Model: the verbatim path, option or round the condition applies to only, or "" for the whole thing.

restricts.description: Code, from labels and the span's place in its line: a required, unscoped include that narrows and is a whole line of its source. Only these, when undisputed and of the main thing, become the row's restriction.

disputed.description: Present when the verifier disputed this condition; it is hidden and never feeds the row.

narrows.description: Model judgment (codebook v3.5): the condition leaves out some students now enrolled at SKKU.

openToAll.description: Evidence, or null when the notice does not state it.

inAttachment.description: Evidence, or null when the notice does not state it.

allRequired.description: Evidence, or null when the notice does not state it.

forStudentsEv.description: The words that limit who can act to non-students (codebook v3.3 forStudentsQuote), located; null when none. The row shows not-for-students only with it.

benefits.description: Concrete things of value, in the order the notice mentions them. The first is the main one (owner, 2026-10-25).

oneOf.description: Parsed by code from the quote. Never summed, averaged or converted (ADR 0008 D3).

value.description: Number in the quote's unit, e.g. 20000 for 2만원.

per.description: What the amount is per, when the quote says.

amount.description: null when the quote has no number.

isDraw.description: earnedBy is draw, or the quote says 추첨.

kind.description: Code: phone or email by pattern.

text.description: At most 20 characters, words from the title or body only.

ok.description: Code: length <= 20 and every word occurs in the title or body. When false the row falls back to the cleaned original title.

compact.description: At most 14 display columns (Hangul 1, ASCII 0.5), for rows that lead with a status token (ADR 0010 D5).

compactOk.description: Code: compact fits 14 columns and every word occurs in the title or body. The server's collision guard falls back to `text` when two rows share one compact title.

verify.description: The verifier pass (design.md "Verifier"): a second model labelled the conditions, the things benefits and costs belong to, and forStudents, without seeing the extractor's labels.

disputes.description: Labels the two readers still disagree on; each fell back to its safe default.

id.description: c<N>, b<N>, k<N> for a condition, benefit or cost; a<N> or p<N> for an action or a placed dated item sent to the scope check (v3.10); or empty.

hidden.description: How many conditions, benefits and costs the disputes hid.

rowCheck.description: The second read (a differently framed model call listing the notice's dates) against the main thing's reader deadline and event dates.

read.description: The second read's answer as returned.
